slides.headline: Frontier models are a **blowtorch.** Most jobs need a knife.
slides.dek: Yash Patil left OpenAI to help companies train custom models on private evals. DoorDash, Cognition, Mercor.

slides.sub: Every company codifies what good looks like. Those scorecards stay private. They will never ship them to frontier providers.

slides.heading: If evals are yours, post-training should be yours too.
paragraphs: Open weights in. Your hill to climb. RLVR on traces that look like the eval, not the internet.
Goldman will not send its production scorecard to a shared frontier API. Neither will DoorDash, Cognition, or Mercor.

slides.label: Applied Compute valuation, year one
slides.sub: Mercor as customer. Ex-OpenAI post-training team.

slides.heading: DoorDash beat frontier on one task.
slides.body: 100k+ merchants onboarded per year. Menu photo in, storefront out. A small specialized model trained on what a good storefront looks like, not general intelligence.
slides.accentSub: merchants per year · one narrow task · owned intelligence

slides.text: 80% of spend on custom models. **20% on frontier.**
slides.sub: Frontier sets the floor. Your model raises the ceiling. AI diffusion into the real economy takes decades, not quarters.

slides.text: Train on your evals. **Keep your moat.**
